summary: Deploy the new Saleor version with state_only migration to preserve the note column during the overlap phase, retire the old version, then execute a contract SQL stage to drop the note column once only the new version remains active and serving traffic.
write_consistency: During the concurrent overlap, the old version continues writing notes through its model (including the note column), while the new version omits the field from INSERT/UPDATE statements, causing the column to receive database DEFAULT (NULL) per Django's behavior. The runner's cross-version consistency checks verify that note values reflect the most recent write from either version. After retire_old, no further writes occur, and the contract stage safely drops the column.

stages.description: Remove the note column from the account_user table. Executed only after retire_old so the old version no longer accesses the database.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user DROP COLUMN note;
